data.title: Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass: Unlock 40+ Rewards
data.summary: Evolve and adapt with the new Battle Pass.
data.meta_title: Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass: Unlock 40+ Rewards
data.content:
Restoration of the Wild Ten warp network continues, and the resourceful Pilots happen upon a merchant vessel. With no manifest, records, or crew aboard, the cargo of supplies and Modules it carries is too tempting to pass up. The salvage operation begins...

The Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass is your way of evolving and adapting to new battles on the Wild Ten. Play to earn XP and Battle Tokens, level up your Pass, and exchange your Battle Tokens for new electrifying content.

Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass

The Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass features the new defensive War Robot—Mesa—and many other valuable rewards, including Salvage, Credits, Premium Account, unique cosmetics, and battle gear!

Battle Passes are only available for a limited time during Seasons. New Shipments of rewards will become available while the Battle Pass is active. You need to complete the Battle Pass while it’s available to unlock everything it has to offer!

  • Battle Pass (Free): Progress without spending a penny! Battle Tokens can be earned through battles and used to level up your Pass. You won’t be able to unlock every reward from all Shipments unless you upgrade to Battle Pass Gold.
  • Battle Pass Gold (200 WarpReals): Upgrade to Battle Pass Gold to earn enough Battle Tokens to obtain every item from the Battle Pass.

Shipment 1

There is no Battle Token requirement to unlock this Shipment.

  • Mesa (War Robot):
    • 1x Shoulder Module
    • 1x Chassis Module
  • NERVE Program Sticker
  • EvoLife Classic Paint
  • Serene Paint
  • FortEvo Prime Paint
  • 6x Locust Weapons
  • Ammo Fabricator Supply Gear
  • Credits
  • Salvage
  • Intel

Shipment 2

Spend 12 Battle Tokens in Shipment 1 to unlock this Shipment.

  • Mesa (War Robot):
    • 1x Torso Module
    • 1x Shoulder Module
  • OldEvo Paint
  • Icarus Classic Paint
  • NERVE Unit Sticker
  • The Lace's Chop Shop Sticker
  • Plate Fungus Wear & Tear
  • Wood Grain Wear & Tear
  • Gamma Beam Cycle Gear
  • Credits
  • Salvage
  • Intel

Shipment 3

Spend 24 Battle Tokens in Shipment 1 and 2 to unlock this Shipment

  • Mesa (War Robot):
    • 1x Chassis Module
  • 3x Locust Weapons
  • 1x Common Pilot
  • Ammo Fabricator Supply Gear
  • Fortified Mycelium Decal
  • Fortified Fiber Decal
  • Multi-Us Sticker
  • Ever Mindful Sticker
  • Riot Squad Wrap
  • Credits
  • Salvage
  • Intel

Shipment 4

Spend 49 Battle Tokens in Shipment 1, 2, and 3 to unlock this Shipment.

  • 160 Intel

Twitch Drops (July 29–August 12)

Tune in to your favorite Twitch streamers from July 29–August 12 to earn Credits, Intel, Modules, Premium time, and a Decal! You can also get additional rewards by buying or gifting subscriptions until August 19. Link your account to get started today.

Sticker Contest

Get your creative juices flowing and design a Sticker for War Robots: Frontiers! Stay tuned for more info.

Battle Bonus Event (July 29–August 12)

Battle three times per day to unlock rewards fit for a cowboy, including Wild West-themed Paint and Sticker, Salvage, and Intel.

Intel Catch-Up Event (July 29–August 26)

Need a boost? Returning players can battle daily for up to seven days, and new players can level up to unlock bonus Intel, a crucial resource used to upgrade your battle Builds.
